infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: blOb needs the camera so you can take check-in photos for Skill Tournaments.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: blOb needs the microphone so you can record check-in or Story videos for Skill Tournaments.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: blOb needs photo access so you can attach proof for Skill Tournaments.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: blOb saves videos and photos you record so you can keep them.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: blOb uses your location only when you tap I’m here to check in at a place.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Alerts for friend requests, Skill Tournament invites, and check-ins.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: blOb reads workouts and heart rate only to verify effort in Skill Tournaments.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: blOb starts or updates a workout session only to verify effort in Skill Tournaments.
